title: Homebase Workflow Contract
description: Schema for <project>/.homebase/workflow.yml. Declares the machine-readable workflow contract that `homebase work` enforces. Replaces SOP prose as the operative control plane. Per-project defaults; per-app overrides under apps[<slug>] (merge for objects, replace for arrays).

version.description: Schema version. The CLI refuses to run on unknown versions. Bumped on breaking changes; prior versions remain readable via a migration shim in scripts/lib/workflow-loader.sh.

primary_tracker.description: Source of truth for issue identifiers. Linear is canonical per HOMEBASE-SOP-013; `github` is supported for projects that haven't adopted SOP-013.

linear.description: Linear workspace integration. Required when primary_tracker == linear.

state_kinds.description: Maps the four canonical workflow phases to the Linear state names this project's team recognizes. State names are read live from Linear at command time; this map answers 'which Linear state is the in_progress one for this team?' Each list MUST contain at least one name; the CLI uses the first entry that exists in the live team-state list.

required_labels_at_start.description: Labels the issue MUST carry before `homebase work start` will accept it. Empty list disables the check.

start_gates.description: Gates evaluated by `homebase work start` before recording work-state. Each gate is a boolean toggle; defaults are conservative (true) per HOMEBASE-SOP-001.

issue_must_be_in_correct_project.description: Issue's Linear Project must equal the resolved app's apps[].roadmap.linear_project_id.

issue_must_have_acceptance_criteria.description: Issue body must contain a `## Acceptance Criteria` section with at least one `- [ ]` checkbox.

branch_must_be_main_or_clean.description: Working branch must be `branch.base` (default `main`), OR a clean feature branch with no diverged history.

plan_approval_required.description: When true, `work start` requires a recent plan-approval marker. Default off because Plan-mode approval is implicit per AUTONOMY_CHARTER §5.

finish_gates.description: Gates evaluated by `homebase work finish`. Each is a boolean toggle. The complete gate sequence is documented in standards/WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md § Finish gates.

all_branch_commits_reference_issue.description: Every commit on the active branch (since branch.base) carries a trailer matching the active issue per scripts/lib/issue-trailer.sh.

last_commit_has_closing_keyword.description: Final commit uses Closes / Fixes / Resolves (not Refs).

validate_command_must_pass.description: Runs each blocking required_checks[] entry with when=on_finish.

docs_validate_must_pass.description: Runs scripts/validate-docs.sh when any commit on the branch touched a `.md` file.

ui_verification_present.description: Per-commit delegation to scripts/hooks/ui-verification-check.sh — UI commits require a Verified-* trailer.

apple_ui_xcuitest_required.description: When true, Apple-platform UI commits must carry `Verified by XCUITest:` or `UI verification waived:` (not bare `Verified on simulator:`/`Verified on device:`). See HOMEBASE-SOP-007 § Apple-platform Gate. Opt-in per Apple app.

branch_must_be_pushed.description: Reserved. As of HMB-22, finish lands work directly on main; this field is retained for back-compat parsing but no longer gates a separate push step.

release_gates.description: HOMEBASE-SOP-005 phases as declarative gates, consumed by `homebase work ship`. Defaults assume web; mobile apps override store_metadata_must_be_localized + store_release_notes_must_exist.

linear_milestone_must_exist.description: Per HOMEBASE-SOP-013: a Linear Milestone matching `v<X.Y.Z>` must exist on the app's Project before ship.

required_agents.description: Maps change-type predicates → required agent slugs. Agents must exist in homebase/agents/. Per-app overrides accumulate.

path_scoped.description: Path-pattern → required agents. Walked top-to-bottom; the first matching pattern's `by_change_kind` wins for that path. Falls through to top-level by_change_kind otherwise. Used for content-vs-code splits (e.g. acme-co blog content routes to acme-co-*-reviewers; non-content code routes to web-frontend-architect).

paths.description: Glob patterns relative to the project root.

required_checks.description: Project-level named checks. Each is a {name, command, when, blocking, min_interval} entry. Per-app overrides REPLACE the array.

min_interval.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive runs of this check (per session). Used to throttle expensive suites; a check skipped due to throttle is treated as passing if a successful run exists within the window.

paths.description: Optional glob array. When present, the check runs only when at least one path in the diff (state.base_sha..HEAD) matches at least one glob; otherwise it's skipped with reason. Use for platform-scoped checks: an iOS-only commit on a multi-platform app skips the Android validate. When absent, the check always runs (current default behaviour).

naming_pattern.description: Branch-name template. Tokens: {scope} (defaults to app slug), {issue} (issue number), {slug} (slugified issue title), {app}, {platform}.

auto_create.description: When true, `homebase work start` calls `git switch -c` automatically.

single_commit_to_main_allowed.description: Per HOMEBASE-SOP-001 §B6: trivial single-commit work may target `branch.base` directly.

hard_rules.description: Named hard rules adopted by this project. Slugs map to entries in governance/HARD_RULES.yml; render-claudemd joins them when rendering the project's `<!-- BEGIN homebase:hard-rules -->` section. Adding a new slug requires updating this enum AND governance/HARD_RULES.yml.

session_end.description: Composes with the Claude Code TaskCompleted hook (scripts/hooks/task-completed.sh).

require_homebase_work_finish.description: When true, task-completed.sh blocks Claude Code task completion unless .homebase/work-state.json shows a successful `homebase work finish` for the active issue.

apps.description: Per-app overrides. Keys are app slugs from .homebase/project.yml. Each value is the same shape as the top-level minus `version` and `apps`. Merge semantics: deep-merge for objects, REPLACE for arrays. Field-level merging is documented in standards/WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md § Per-app overrides.

notes.description: Free-form prose for human readers. Ignored by the CLI.

app_workflow_override.description: Per-app override block. Same shape as the top-level minus `version` and `apps`. Includes `hard_rules` so an app can opt into rules its parent project doesn't adopt project-wide.
